'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Michael Richards LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Michael Richards]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Kyle Krueger drinks his own pee. Transcription note: 2002-style form without V boxes; ticked lines may mean (V). Deck name is as written on the sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We Have A Plan]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
